title: CDS Special Chai Masala
description: A warm, aromatic chai masala with a strong cardamom-forward flavor, balanced by fennel, ginger, cinnamon, cloves, and black pepper. Perfect for everyday masala chai.
steps: Lightly dry roast the fennel seeds, green cardamom, cloves, black peppercorns, and cinnamon over low heat for 2-3 minutes until fragrant.
Allow the spices to cool completely.
Transfer the roasted spices to a spice grinder.
Add the dried ginger powder, freshly grated nutmeg, and a pinch of salt.
Store in an airtight glass jar away from heat and moisture.
notes: Use about 1/2 teaspoon per 2 cups (500 ml) of chai.
Add the masala while the tea is simmering to fully extract the flavors.
Freshly grinding the spice blend produces a much brighter aroma than pre-ground spices.
This blend is intentionally cardamom-forward, giving the chai a sweeter and more fragrant profile.
